function.name: run_sql
function.arguments: {"sql":"SELECT account_code, period, SUM(amount_cad) AS total_cad FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.gl_balance WHERE account_type='opex' AND period IN ('2026-08','2026-09') GROUP BY account_code, period ORDER BY account_code, period","purpose":"All OPEX accounts for Aug vs Sep"}
